title: MultibandZone — per-zone dynamics, controls
description:
Implement per-zone multiband dynamics and controls, reusing EnvelopeFollower / soft-knee helpers from phase C, per SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §5.4.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/SHREDEQ_SPEC.md §5.2 and §5.4 (zone names and per-zone controls)
- Source/DSP/EnvelopeFollower.h/.cpp (ballistics, soft-knee, transient/sustain — read only; reuse)
- Source/DSP/DynamicProcessor.* public patterns if present (read only; do not re-own full mode matrix unless thin reuse helps)
- Source/DSP/MultibandCrossover.h public split API from e.1 (read only)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h multiband per-zone parameter IDs if present (read only)

Implement Source/DSP/MultibandZone.h and Source/DSP/MultibandZone.cpp:
1. MultibandZone class representing one of Weight/Body/Bite/Fizz: prepare(sampleRate, maxBlockSize), reset(), process(float* samples, numSamples) or channel-aware equivalent — no heap in process.
2. Static zone make-up/gain in dB applied as linear gain (or smoothed) independent of dynamics.
3. Dynamics path reusing EnvelopeFollower (and soft-knee / dual-envelope helpers as appropriate): threshold, ratio, attack, hold, release, dynamic range cap, upward or downward operation, optional auto-threshold hook as a simple level offset or enable flag if ParameterIDs imply it.
4. Transient emphasis and sustain emphasis map onto transient/sustain separation (scale GR or drive from e_f/e_s components) rather than inventing a third envelope system.
5. solo, mute, bypass flags: mute → silence zone; bypass → pass zone audio with static gain only / no dynamics; solo is a data flag for the engine to mute non-soloed zones (document contract).
6. Detector source enum/field (internal / external sidechain placeholder) and stereo placement field as data for engine/processor — do not own full M/S encode redesign; apply simple mid/side leg gain if placement requires and matches existing DSP patterns.
7. Setters clamp to sensible guitar/bass multiband ranges; zipper-safe gain and threshold updates.
8. Optional getters: current GR dB, zone energy, bypass/solo/mute state for GUI/tests.

Do NOT edit MultibandCrossover, MultibandEngine, PluginProcessor, CMakeLists.txt, or tests.
acceptance_criteria: MultibandZone reuses EnvelopeFollower (or its soft-knee/transient helpers) for per-zone dynamics with threshold, ratio, attack, hold, release, and range cap
Zone controls include gain, solo, mute, bypass, transient emphasis, sustain emphasis, upward/downward mode, and detector/placement fields per §5.4
Bypass disables dynamics while mute silences; solo is exposed for engine-level non-solo muting
No heap allocation in per-sample or per-block process paths
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: implement LR4 crossover tree or PluginProcessor fan-in

allowed: float buffer API matching sibling DSP
solo as flag consumed by MultibandEngine
simple placement/detector enums without owning sidechain buses
